title: IL governor J.B. Pritzker urges resistance. “If it sounds like I’m becoming...
content: IL governor J.B. Pritzker urges resistance. “If it sounds like I’m becoming contemptuous of Donald Trump and the people that he has elevated, it’s because… I am. You should be too. They are an affront to every value this country was founded upon.”
author: Jason Kottke
